Remember this distinction: adapted physical education specialists help children move, while special education teachers help children learn. One trains the body; the other supports learning, and the roles complement each other.

The biggest risk in this occupation is limited funded positions plus mixed qualification requirements. Adapted physical education roles are scarce and often sit within special education or rehabilitation, while practitioners must understand both fields. One-on-one support and individualized plans remain difficult for AI to replace in the near term.

subject.name: Adapted Physical Education Specialists
subject.summary: Adapted physical education specialists design movement around each child's needs. They adapt physical education so children who use wheelchairs or have visual or intellectual disabilities can participate, building both physical ability and confidence.
